themes_detail.label: Traffic Surge This Week
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints spiked to 3 reports THIS WEEK compared to a 0.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 1100% increase (z-score: 6.35)—signaling a potential new congestion or transit disruption pattern in East Flatbush.
evidence: 3 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Spike emerged abruptly this week with no prior escalation pattern
Statistically significant anomaly suggests acute, not chronic, issue
reporting_angles: Interview residents and delivery drivers about congestion hotspots and whether a specific construction project or transit change triggered this week's spike
Cross-reference with DOB building permits (304 filings in last 90 days, including 79 new buildings) to see if active construction is creating street blockages

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints Jump
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (likely Uber/Lyft-related) jumped to 4 reports THIS WEEK versus a 0.8 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 433% spike (z-score: 4.91)—indicating emerging driver conduct or congestion issues in the district.
evidence: 4 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.8 weekly average (433% increase, z-score 4.91)
First major spike of this metric in the 8-week observation window
Timing aligns with this week's traffic spike, suggesting related street-level disruption
reporting_angles: Speak with residents about specific complaints: illegal pickups/dropoffs, double-parking, reckless driving by ride-share drivers
Check if complaints correlate with any new ride-share marketing push or TLC enforcement changes

themes_detail.label: Dumpster & Sanitation Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dumpster complaints surged to 5 reports LAST WEEK versus a 0.5 weekly average—a 900% spike (z-score: 6.36)—while unsanitary conditions remain the 5th highest complaint type overall (988 in 90 days), suggesting emerging waste management failures.
evidence: 5 dumpster complaints LAST WEEK vs 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score 6.36)
Unsanitary condition complaints are consistently high: 988 total over 90 days (5th most common complaint type)
Suggests systemic waste collection failure, not isolated incident
reporting_angles: Investigate Sanitation Department pickup schedules and staffing in East Flatbush; are routes being skipped or delayed?
Interview residents and business owners about overflowing dumpsters, rodent activity, and odor complaints; map complaint addresses to identify geographic hotspots

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Alert Pattern
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints hit 5 reports 3 WEEKS AGO—a 900% spike versus a 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 9.0)—the highest severity z-score in the dataset, indicating potential industrial emissions, construction dust, or traffic pollution concerns in the district.
evidence: 5 air quality complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, highest z-score at 9.0)
304 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (174 alterations, 79 new buildings, 7 demolitions) could be source of dust/emissions
Spike occurred 3 weeks ago, not this week, but severity remains the single highest statistical anomaly
reporting_angles: Identify which construction sites filed permits in the weeks before the spike; conduct site visits to assess dust control and emission management
Interview residents about respiratory symptoms or odor complaints; check if schools or hospitals nearby have reported air quality concerns

themes_detail.label: Water Quality & Infrastructure Concern
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints soared to 3 reports 2 WEEKS AGO—a 2300% spike versus a 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 8.69, severity: high)—coupled with 554 water leak complaints over 90 days, signaling potential main breaks or contamination in East Flatbush's water system.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score 8.69, second-highest severity)
554 water leak complaints over 90 days indicates chronic underlying infrastructure problem
Heat/hot water remains top complaint (4012 in 90 days), possibly exacerbated by water system issues
reporting_angles: Request DEP records of water main breaks and boil water notices for East Flatbush from the past month; determine if quality spike correlates with repairs
Interview residents about discolored water, low pressure, or boil orders; consult plumbers about call volume for emergency repairs
